agent_turns: Hello Jordan, I'm here to help with your claim. Are you and everyone else involved in a safe place right now?
I'm glad to hear everyone is safe, and I've noted that email is your preferred way to connect.
That is perfectly alright. Did you happen to exchange information with the driver who hit you?
That's completely fine, many minor incidents don't require a report. Do you have any estimates or receipts for repairs yet?
I understand, that's completely fine. I have everything I need right now. Your claim packet is ready, you can review it in the app, and once you submit it, an adjuster will get started on it.
